evidence_against.relevance: Remembering Jordan's presentation, sending encouragement, and including Jordan's preferred tea show personal attentiveness that could support A.
Repeated extended texting that included personal updates could indicate interest beyond routine group interaction.
Alex also did not describe the relationship as platonic, so this fact does not rule out A.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Alex is broadly warm, checks in on several group members, and makes one-on-one plans with other friends, so the behavior toward Jordan is not clearly distinctive.
Only one of the two one-on-one outings was suggested by Alex, which provides limited evidence of special pursuit.
Alex did not label either outing as a date or initiate explicitly romantic physical contact.
After postponing Jordan's dinner proposal, Alex expressed general willingness but did not offer a specific alternative time.

recommended_action.explanation: The record better supports general friendliness, but some ambiguity remains; maintaining the current level avoids treating uncertain signals as clearly romantic.

uncertainty_explanation: Alex's attentiveness and repeated personal texting are compatible with special interest, but the broader pattern of warmth toward others, limited Alex-initiated one-on-one activity, absence of explicit romantic behavior, and nonspecific response to another dinner make general friendliness the better-supported interpretation.
